name: envp
install: export PATH="/nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin:$HOME/.nix-profile/bin:$PATH"; command -v nix >/dev/null || curl -fsSL https://install.determinate.systems/nix | sh -s -- install linux --init none --no-confirm && nix profile add "github:NixOS/nixpkgs/$(nix eval --raw --impure --expr '(builtins.fromJSON (builtins.readFile ./flake.lock)).nodes.nixpkgs.locked.rev')#devenv" && devenv shell -- true
